title: 2025 MoEE Software Engineering Exit Exam
source: 2025 Ethiopian University Exit Exam for Software Engineering (MoEE blueprint)

focusGuide.Fundamentals of Programming: Loops, variables, operators, complexity, modular design, Python/Java/C basics.
focusGuide.Data Structures: Linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, sorting, graph algorithms, Big-O.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Inheritance, encapsulation, polymorphism, this/super, method overriding.
focusGuide.Web Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, HTTP methods, Django/frameworks.
focusGuide.Android: Activities, Intents, Manifest, Java/Kotlin, mobile security.
focusGuide.Software Engineering: SDLC models, Agile, UML, feasibility, NFRs.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Architecture role, design patterns, quality attributes, UML structure.
focusGuide.Project Management: WBS, Gantt, risk, Scrum roles, scheduling.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Unit/white-box testing, test cases, QA goals, defects.
focusGuide.Software Maintenance: Maintenance types, refactoring, complexity cost, reliability.
focusGuide.Networking: OSI model, routing, HTTPS, subnet mask, gateways.
focusGuide.Security: Encryption, SQL injection, firewall, MFA, patching.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Agents, search, expert systems, supervised/unsupervised, overfitting.
